Phase 3 findings — filed 2 Nov (Bug, Sprint 14)

NDC-2774With business hours set to Mon–Fri, blueprint state and SLA due times still count SaturdayG6, K8High

Ticket entered Mon 2 Nov 11:57: blueprint state (5 days, business clock) due Sat 11:57; department SLA resolution (120 business hours) due 07/11/2026 11:57 while showing "4 days 11 hours of business time left". Holidays are skipped correctly.

NDC-2775A status a live blueprint uses can be removed when no ticket is in it, and tickets then move into the removed statusC20Medium

Removal accepted (200); a transition then moves ticket #1109 into "QA BP Verify", no longer a status. With a ticket already in the state the removal is refused (FIELD_OPTION_IN_BLUEPRINT).

Phase 2 findings — filed 2 Nov (Bug, Sprint 14)

NDC-2761The API saves a state warning that is not before the time limitG3Medium

slaMinutes 120 + warning 120 → 201; warning 120 with limit 60 → 201; a warning with no limit → 201. The designer blocks this ("The warning must come before the time limit.").

NDC-2762The API saves a negative time limitG4Medium

slaMinutes −1 → 201 (0 is also saved; 1.5 and text are refused).

NDC-2763The API saves an automatic move pointing at a transition from another stateG5Medium

State Open with autoTransitionId = a transition that starts at Escalated → 201. The same mistake in customer triggers is refused (G9).

NDC-2764A workflow rule can change Status on a ticket the blueprint controlsL3High

QA workflow On Edit, Field Update Status = Closed: after a transition the rule ran, Status became Closed and the ticket left the blueprint. A direct API status change on the same ticket is refused (TICKET_IN_BLUEPRINT). Same family as NDC-2730 (CRM). Happens through normal admin setup.

NDC-2761 to 2763 happen only through the API (the designer prevents them), like NDC-2758, but a blueprint saved that way can go live and its timers silently fail. NDC-2764 happens through normal admin setup.

Other notes

  • A blueprint created by API and made active shows "Draft" in the designer header while it governs tickets.
  • A required multi-select field accepts an empty list.
  • No length limit on blueprint names (309 characters saved); duplicate names in one department are allowed.
  • In Arabic (right to left), a name ending in ">" shows the bracket at the start.
  • Moving a ticket to another department takes it out of the blueprint; Zoho refuses the move.
  • The state's own timer keeps running while the ticket's status is On Hold (the department SLA pauses).

Incident during the run

At about 23:49 on 1 Nov a test script opened two browser sessions from one saved sign-in. Both refreshed the same token and the server signed the owner account out everywhere. Anyone using that account then was logged out. The scripts now use one session per sign-in.
